review_description: Honey Solar put in the time during the sales process to explain everything in detail and answer our questions. Notably they were the only ones of the 3 we contacted who actually came onsite at the start of the process rather than just send a quote based on a look at Google Earth.They gave a range of options in price and brand, and helped us through the whole process of grid connection approval, prompt and courteous installation, and explained the app and usage of the system.

Very competitive pricing, great customer service from initial system design and throughout installation process. Always responsive to queries and requests along the way. Extremely knowledgeable and helpful sales staff. Installation professional and responsive to any challenges or changes required. Made the process easy and seamless took care of everything. Highly recommend.

Ellie from Honey Solar visited my home to do an inspection, provide a quote, and help answer any questions. She proved extremely helpful at every stage of the project. Kevin managed the install of the panels, battery and switchboard, ensuring everything was done precisely. Would definitely recommend their company for outstanding customer service and competitive pricing.

Very knowledgeable and Honey Solar just get it done. They listen to the customer.  They clean up and other than a whopping panel array on the roof leave little behind. Our smart meter is scheduled for installation thanks to Honey Solar.  We are very grateful to Honey Solar.

I was very happy with the service provided to me by Ellie & Kevin. Both were incredibly professional and easy to work with, throughout the process.On the day, Kevin managed everything smoothly and ensured it was done to a high standard. I am very happy with the outcome.I would highly recommend Honey Solar for anyone looking to install solar or a battery.

From the moment I contacted Ellie, she was always a delight to speak with and had so much knowledge and experience. She provided us with a great range of options and quotes that suited our needs and budget. And the best thing, she took care of everything from helping us fill out forms to stepping us through the App. What's more, the head electrician, Kevin, who installed our system was also great. Kind, courteous, punctual and thorough. I would highly recommend HoneySolar, Ellie and Kevin to anyone thinking about investing in Solar. Cheers Dean

Ellie and her team at Honey solar were simply fantastic. They did a very thorough and neat installation, explained how to operate the system and were very helpful throughout the process. I would highly recommend them.

Excellent service.  Honey Solar visited our home, listened to everything we hoped to achieve, answered our many questions and guided us throughout.  Honey Solar discussed the install on the day before starting, kept me informed throughout the day and briefed me on how to use the system on completion.  The install went as planned, is extremely neat and tidy, and is generating the daily production of electricity forecast.  We could not be more pleased with Honey Solar’s service.
Ellie discussed our hybrid solar requirements clearly, and Kevin and the team installed the system on the scheduled date. The system is working well!

Big thank you to Ellie and the team at honey solar, they have done the amazing job to install the solar for our home. From start to finish Ellie is always happy to answer and help with all my endless questions and provide top level customer service to us. I will highly recommend her and honey solar to anyone need to install the solar for their homes.

Outstanding service and installation of my EV  Smart charger. Put into contact with Honey Solar through SolarQuotes. Ellie the Project Director responded quickly and set up a time to visit site and explain the options available. From accepting quote to installation was less than 1 week .The installers were thorough, careful and professional and tidied up the site completely after installation was completed. They spent considerable time making sure the charger was working properly and explained the key features. Would highly recommend Honey Solar and Ellie for any of your solar needs.

Excellent customer service, from quoting, installation and post sales support. We had a 10kw system quoted and the price is competitive considering we have an old system that needed to be removed as well. The quote is very comprehensive and Ellie is very detailed and patient in making everything easy to understand. On the day of installation, Kevin and crew was there on time and managed to finish the job in 1 day as promised. Site was left clean and tidy and proper handover was done even though it was quite late in the day already. All in all, a very stress free experience and couldn't find fault in the customer service. Highly recommended!

Sales and quoting process was easy. We had limited room in our board and the installer (Kevin) came out to assess and proposed solutions for the install to ensure we got what we wanted. Ellie who did the quote was on time and was very polite and professional. We have kept in touch as I've had questions since the installation as well and Ellie has been very prompt and helpful.

I recently chose Honey Solar Pty Ltd for my solar panel installation, and I couldn't be more pleased with their service. From start to finish, the process was seamless and stress-free.The team at Honey Solar Pty Ltd was incredibly professional and knowledgeable. They provided a detailed in-house quote and patiently answered all my questions, ensuring I understood every aspect of the installation process. Their customer service was top-notch, making me feel valued and respected as a customer. On the day of installation, the technicians Kevin and Lee arrived promptly and worked efficiently. They demonstrated excellent craftsmanship and attention to detail, ensuring the solar panels were installed perfectly. The installation site was left clean and tidy, reflecting their commitment to quality work.I highly recommend Honey Solar Pty Ltd to anyone considering solar panel installation.

Honey Solar were prompt, patient, informative and professional.  Communication was amazing and their quote was very reasonable. The install was seamless and I could not recommend them more highly. Fantastic job from start to finish!

I had a number of quotes but decided to go ahead with Honey Solar. Ellie come at visited our house and gave us a number of options to chose from. Her manner was relaxed and hepful not like the high pressure tactics of some of the other installets.The quotes from her arrived soon after her visit and were very competitive. We arranged a date for installation and they arrive on time and competitive the installation in one day. The quality of there workmanship was good and they took time to ensure there would be no leaks from the tiled roof.I am very happy with the job they did and would be happy to recommed them to others

The sales lady gave me good advice what system i should have based on how much I spent on electricity and how big the system should be to fulfill all my need. The quote came back in a reasonable figure. The installation went thru smoothly and no hassle. The system works instantly as soon as the system is up. All the paperwork are being taken care of by the installer. I have great respect on this company.

Good and attentive, efficient and professional service provided. Very helpful in pointing out the critical preparation work, particularly in the area of electrical board upgrade and smart meter exchange before proceeding the installation. Other competitors would just simply sell their products without cautioning the customer. Honey Solar had provided real and practical solutions from start to finishing the project. Highly recommended.

Honey Solar impressed me with their speed and professionalism throughout the entire process.Ellie conducted an on-site inspection to discuss my options. She patiently explained the installation and how to maximise my system given the limited roof space.The installation was completed by Kevin who was very thorough and ensured that I fully understood how to use and maintain the system.From the initial consultation to the final installation, Honey Solar provided exceptional customer service. They were always happy to answer my questions and address any concerns I had.I'm very happy with the overall outcome andwould highly recommend Honey Solar to anyone considering solar panels.
